name: Vulkan Tank Online
tagline: A multiplayer tank game written directly on Vulkan, with no game engine.

awards: Beenox - Sponsor Challenge // Beenox - Défi commandité

problem: The team wanted to build a networked game without an engine.
solution: A C++ Vulkan renderer with shadow mapping and model loading plus Valve's networking library for multiplayer, with a virtual network to get around venue Wi-Fi isolation.
demo_moment: Team-described: two players drive tanks across machines.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Beenox - Sponsor Challenge // Beenox - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Took on low-level graphics and networking in 24 hours.

lessons: A games sponsor rewards engineering it recognises as hard.
